title: Aligning Large Language Models by On-Policy Self-Judgment

bias_targets.methodology: Tracking the average response length and 4-gram repetition of selected responses during the self-rejection sampling phase to evaluate whether the judge model disproportionately favors longer, more verbose responses.

Evaluating pairwise comparisons by utilizing a position-swapped judgment template and averaging the relative likelihoods of the judge tokens for each response to mitigate the model's tendency to favor a specific presentation order (e.g., always preferring the first option).
